question_text:
Which sentence uses correct tense consistency?

A. The DOST incident report stated that the equipment malfunctioned after the technician performed the upgrade.
B. The DOST incident report stated that the equipment had malfunctioned after the technician performed the upgrade.
C. The DOST incident report stated that the equipment malfunctioned after the technician had performed the upgrade.
D. The DOST incident report stated that the equipment had malfunctioned after the technician had performed the upgrade.
